patterns.message: Quarantined (Phase 3F.1.4): lib/contract-model/service.ts is the legacy Phase C query layer, populated only by the legacy 11-stage compiler (lib/contract-model/compiler/orchestrator.ts's runContractCompiler), which carries a never-closed dangerous-unflagged error rate (25.0% -> 15.625%) above its own required <=5% safety gate. See docs/HEADROOM-ROADMAP.md §1 'The pre-Phase-2 "Phase C" compiler'.

Quarantined (Phase 3F.1.4): lib/contract-model/validators.ts is the legacy Phase C validation layer, populated only by the same quarantined legacy compiler as service.ts. See docs/HEADROOM-ROADMAP.md §1.

Quarantined (Phase 3F.1.4): runContractCompiler is the legacy Phase C 11-stage rule-extraction pipeline. Its RULE_EXTRACTION/VERIFICATION/PROMOTION stages carry a never-closed dangerous-unflagged error rate (25.0% -> 15.625%), both above the required <=5% safety gate, and must never be wired into app/. See docs/HEADROOM-ROADMAP.md §1.
